00042 /**
00043 * @brief Property set Index 
00044 *
00045 * Each property domain can have a set of instances. This index defines the index of
00046 * each instance in the set.
00047 *
00048 * For example, the usb domain could contain multiple devices. The Index would
00049 * enumerate the usb devices.
00050 *
00051 */
00052 typedef uint32_t HxPropertyIndex_t;            /**< Property set index */
